description: How to reach a point in Milwaukee without a car, and where to park or charge: up to three MCTS bus stops within 400 m with the routes that serve them, Bublr bike share docks within 400 m with live bike and dock counts, public EV chargers within 400 m with connector types, the nearest parking meter with its zone and rate, and the nearest publicly owned parking structure within 800 m. Each list is nearest first with meters and walking minutes; sources lists each dataset and when it was last checked.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, for example 43.0716.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, for example -87.8879.

name: getting_there
